reader_contract.problem_3s: A ready shipment is waiting for a second PO, but the customer date may not permit the hold.
reader_contract.insight_10s: The maximum defensible hold is the smaller of the service-safe limit and the economic break-even limit across every credible scenario.
reader_contract.action_30s: Check compatibility and input freshness, calculate both limits, then ship, consolidate, stop, review, or escalate with the reason recorded.

selected_direction: Direction B — The Last Safe Departure
coherence_rationale: The contradiction earns attention, the route-to-deadline makes the decision legible, the two-limit formula supplies a saveable method, and the calculator continues the same release decision with the reader's current inputs.

atoms.source_mechanism: A sharp correction separates the familiar label from the decision that actually matters.
atoms.adaptation: Open on the contradiction that a freight saving can be real while holding the shipment is still impermissible.

references.anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse 'NOT every X is equal,' immature-versus-mature categories, the central VS spine, source wording, palette, labels, artwork, or branding.
references.visual_inspection_note: The portrait asset uses two opposing columns separated by a dark category spine. Only the immediate contrast mechanism is retained; the source composition and expression are excluded.

atoms.source_mechanism: Ordered layers make a complex operating system understandable as a small sequence of questions.
atoms.adaptation: Convert the layers into one route: current data and compatibility, service deadline, differential economics, then a recorded decision.

references.anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the three-layer engine, demand/supply/execution framing, 'sense/simulate/decide/adapt,' source icons, numbered layout, palette, wording, artwork, or branding.
references.visual_inspection_note: The asset presents three large numbered layers with an explicit top-down reading path and supporting sidebars. The new direction uses only the staged-question principle and changes the object, number of stages, direction, and visual grammar.

atoms.source_mechanism: A method becomes saveable when calculation, interpretation, and practical use condition are kept together.
atoms.adaptation: Show the service-safe hold and economic break-even hold separately, then state that the smaller limit governs across all credible scenarios.

references.anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse the forecasting subject, method list, mini charts, blue/orange card system, source wording, card composition, artwork, or branding.
references.visual_inspection_note: The source repeats compact method cards that pair a miniature visual with a short explanation and use condition. The new asset changes the subject and composition and retains only the complete-method utility principle.

atoms.source_mechanism: A complete on-feed diagnostic creates a legitimate bridge to a deeper execution resource.
atoms.adaptation: Give the full release rule on LinkedIn, then offer the no-email calculator only for live dates, quotes, scenarios, and an auditable decision record.

references.anti_copy_boundary: Do not reuse tactical-to-strategic framing, the seven-panel guide, chess or target motifs, red-green stop/go styling, 'free guide' CTA, source wording, artwork, or branding.
references.visual_inspection_note: The source is a dense multi-part procurement guide that delivers substantial feed value before the external-resource bridge. The new direction keeps that value sequencing but uses a single deadline race and a different destination utility.
